r0c2.en: <align="center">Significantly reduces the host's weapon attack accuracy.\nImpairs the host's vision\u002c making it difficult to <color=#6fb6ff><u><link="研读书籍">read</link></u></color></align> when the month advances.
r0c2.cn: <align="center">使宿主的兵器攻击的命中几率降低50%；\n还会使宿主视物艰难，无法在月份更替时<color=#6fb6ff><u><link="研读书籍">研读书籍</link></u></color></align>

r0c3.en: <align="center">The host's weapon attack hit rate against enemies is further increased.</align>
r0c3.cn: <align="center">宿主的兵器攻击命中敌人的几率额外提高25%（+75%）</align>
r0c3.ru: <align="center">Скорость Атаки Оружием хозяина по врагам еще больше увеличивается.</align>

r0c4.en: <align="center">The host's weapon attack hit rate against enemies is further decreased.</align>
r0c4.cn: <align="center">宿主的兵器攻击命中敌人的几率额外降低25%（-75%）</align>
r0c4.ru: <align="center">Скорость попадания при Атаке Оружием хозяина по врагам еще больше снижается.</align>

r0c5.en: <align="center">The host will lose some items during the Month Advance.</align>
r0c5.cn: <align="center">宿主在月份更替时会遗失3件随机物品</align>
r0c5.ru: <align="center">Хозяин потеряет некоторые предметы в течение месяца вперед.</align>

r1c2.en: <align="center">Applies 1 Daze Marker to the host when their poison bursts\u002c based on the Gu's remaining lifespan.\nCauses the host to act strangely\u002c greatly reducing Favorability with up to 3 nearby characters when the month advances</align>.
r1c2.cn: <align="center">在宿主毒发时，根据蛊虫的剩余存活时间给宿主添加1个失神标记；\n还会使宿主行止怪异，在月份更替时与随机最多3个临近的人物的好感-4000</align>

r1c3.en: <align="center">Inflicts minor Daze damage on the enemy whenever the host's poison takes effect\u002c scaling with the Gu's remaining duration.</align>
r1c3.cn: <align="center">宿主毒性发作时，由螭魅蛊对敌人造成的失神伤害翻倍（造成失神伤害 = 蛊虫剩余存活时间 × 200）</align>

r1c4.en: <align="center">Inflicts minor Daze damage on the host whenever the host's poison takes effect\u002c scaling with the Gu's remaining duration.</align>
r1c4.cn: <align="center">宿主毒性发作时，由螭魅蛊对宿主造成的失神伤害翻倍（造成失神伤害 = 蛊虫剩余存活时间 × 200）</align>

r1c5.en: <align="center">During the Month Advance\u002c the host will inexplicably become vindictive against those whose Favorability has greatly decreased and will more readily seek revenge on foes.</align>
r1c5.cn: <align="center">宿主在月份更替时还会无端仇视那些与其好感大幅下降的人物，且寻仇概率提高900%</align>

r2c2.en: <align="center">Greatly reduces the effects of healing\u002c detoxification\u002c and healing concoctions on its host.\nPrevents the host's <color=#6fb6ff><u><link="伤势">injuries</link></u></color> from healing as the month advances</align>.
r2c2.cn: <align="center">使宿主治疗伤势、驱除毒素、服食治疗丹药的效果降低50%；\n还会使宿主伤不能愈，宿主所受<color=#6fb6ff><u><link="伤势">伤势</link></u></color>无法随月份更替自然减轻</align>

r2c3.en: <align="center">The level of the host's Openings and Sealed Acupoints decreases by 1.</align>
r2c3.cn: <align="center">宿主受到的破绽、封穴级别减少1级</align>
r2c3.ru: <align="center">Уровень отверстий хозяина и запечатанных акупунктурных точек уменьшается на 1.</align>

r2c4.en: <align="center">The level of the host's Openings and Sealed Acupoints increases by 1.</align>
r2c4.cn: <align="center">宿主受到的破绽、封穴级别增加1级</align>
r2c4.ru: <align="center">Уровень отверстий хозяина и запечатанных акупунктурных точек увеличивается на 1.</align>

r2c5.en: <align="center">The host will suffer from Inner Breath Chaos during the Month Advance based on the injury level.</align>
r2c5.cn: <align="center">宿主在月份更替时增加内息紊乱 = 伤势层数总和 × 20</align>

r3c2.en: <align="center">Further reduces a random type of the host's True Qi by 2 upon the reduction of the host's True Qi and grants the opponent up to 90 Gu Baits based on the host's original True Qi reduction.\nTriggers the host's malicious thoughts\u002c increasing the host's <color=#6fb6ff><u><link="入魔程度">Deviation</link></u></color> on the new month.</align>
r3c2.cn: <align="center">在宿主的真气减少时，使宿主随机类型的真气再减少2点，并根据宿主原本减少的真气数量使对手获得蛊引，最多获得90只蛊引；\n还会使宿主恶念丛生，在月份更替时使宿主的<color=#6fb6ff><u><link="入魔程度">入魔程度</link></u></color>+5</align>

r3c3.en: <align="center">When the host's True Qi increases\u002c it randomly causes another type of True Qi in the host to increase by 2.</align>
r3c3.cn: <align="center">宿主的真气增加时，使宿主随机类型的真气再增加2点（+4）</align>

r3c4.en: <align="center">When the host's True Qi decreases\u002c it randomly causes another type of True Qi in the host to decrease by 2.</align>
r3c4.cn: <align="center">宿主的真气减少时，使宿主随机类型的真气再减少2点（-4）</align>

r3c5.en: <align="center">During the Month Advance\u002c the increase of the host's Mania and Deviation is multiplied by 10.</align>
r3c5.cn: <align="center">宿主在月份更替时的入魔程度的增加量变为10倍（+50）</align>

r4c1.cn: <align="center"><color=#9eb767><u><link="功法-九阴尸螭蛊"><color=#GradeColor_5>九阴尸螭蛊</color></link></u></color></align>

r4c2.en: <align="center">Greatly increases the Direct DMG of Annihilation Martial Arts taken by the host.\nCauses the host's flesh to wither\u002c reducing the host's Health when the month advances.</align>
r4c2.cn: <align="center">使宿主受到的摧破功法的直接伤害提高40%；\n还会使宿主血肉凋零，在月份更替时使宿主的健康-60</align>

r4c3.en: <align="center">If the host's Health is not below 50%\u002c the Wound Damage received by the host is additionally decreased. But the more the Wound Damage is decreased\u002c the more the host's Health will decrease.</align>
r4c3.cn: <align="center">如果宿主的健康不低于50%，宿主受到的重创伤害额外降低25%，但被降低的重创伤害越多，宿主的健康也会减少越多</align>

r4c4.en: <align="center">If the host's Health is not below 50%\u002c the Wound Damage received by the host is additionally increased. And the more the Wound Damage is increased\u002c the more the host's Health will decrease.</align>
r4c4.cn: <align="center">如果宿主的健康不低于50%，宿主受到的重创伤害额外提高25%，且被提高的重创伤害越多，宿主的健康也会减少越多</align>

r4c5.en: <align="center">The host's Health cannot be restored during the Month Advance based on their state of Inner Breath.</align>
r4c5.cn: <align="center">宿主的健康无法在月份更替时因内息状况而得到恢复</align>

r5c1.cn: <align="center"><color=#9eb767><u><link="功法-碧玉冰蚕蛊"><color=#GradeColor_6>碧玉冰蚕蛊</color></link></u></color></align>

r5c2.en: <align="center">Greatly increases the duration for which the host's Martial Arts and Weapons are sealed.\nCauses the host to lose vitality\u002c making them age faster as the month advances</align>.
r5c2.cn: <align="center">使宿主的功法、兵器被封禁的时间提高60%；\n还会使宿主更易衰老，每次身龄增加时额外增加1岁</align>

r5c3.en: <align="center">The chance of the host's Martial Arts and weapons being sealed further decreases.</align>
r5c3.cn: <align="center">宿主的功法、兵器被封禁的几率额外降低50%</align>

r5c4.en: <align="center">The chance of the host's Martial Arts and weapons being sealed further increases.</align>
r5c4.cn: <align="center">宿主的功法、兵器被封禁的几率额外提高50%</align>

r5c5.en: <align="center">The host's Qi cannot be restored during the Month Advance and will significantly deplete.</align>
r5c5.cn: <align="center">宿主的内力无法在月份更替时恢复，且每月流失50%</align>

r6c1.cn: <align="center"><color=#9eb767><u><link="功法-王蛊金蚕降"><color=#GradeColor_7>鬼噬金蚕蛊</color></link></u></color></align>

r6c2.en: <align="center">Devours all other Gu Larvae just implanted during battle and then inflicts heavy Toxin on the host and increases direct DMG taken\u002c based on the devoured Gu.\nInflicts severe physical and mental damage\u002c causing the host to suffer a <color=#6fb6ff><u><link="走火入魔">Pure Deviation</link></u></color></align> at every step while attempting a Martial Arts Breakthrough.
r6c2.cn: <align="center">会吞噬宿主在战斗中刚种下的所有其它若蛊，并根据所吞噬的蛊向宿主施加10倍于对应蛊降功法所含的毒素、使宿主所受直接伤害提高10%；\n还会使宿主身心俱损，宿主在突破功法时每一步都会<color=#6fb6ff><u><link="走火入魔">走火入魔</link></u></color></align>

r6c3.en: <align="center">The Pure Essence Suppression from Pure Essence effects granted to the host by Body Purification\u002c Spirit Fullness\u002c and Transcendent Realm are increased.</align>
r6c3.cn: <align="center">宿主由洗浊、神足、入化赋予的精纯境界效果中的精纯压制效果提高50%</align>

r6c4.en: <align="center">The Pure Essence Suppression from Pure Essence effects granted to the host by Body Purification\u002c Spirit Fullness\u002c and Transcendent Realm are decreased.</align>
r6c4.cn: <align="center">宿主由洗浊、神足、入化赋予的精纯境界效果中的精纯压制效果降低50%</align>

r6c5.en: <align="center">During the Month Advance\u002c the Prime Aureate Gu will randomly devour one of the host's developed Gu and inflict a large amount of toxin on the host.</align>
r6c5.cn: <align="center">金蚕王蛊在月份更替时还会随机吞噬宿主体内的1个成蛊，并根据所吞噬的蛊向宿主施加10倍于对应蛊降功法所含的毒素</align>

r7c1.cn: <align="center"><color=#9eb767><u><link="功法-百彩青髓蛊"><color=#GradeColor_8>百彩青髓蛊</color></link></u></color></align>

r7c2.en: <align="center">When the host is Wounded\u002c randomly transforms a newly channeled Gu Larva into a fully developed un-attuned Gu Larva\u002c or advances the host's developed Gu Larva into Gu.\nIt also compels the host to seek the company of the opposite sex. If the host undergoes the Month Advance without a member of the opposite sex nearby\u002c they will suffer from a multitude of random poisoning.</align>
r7c2.cn: <align="center">在宿主受到重创时，随机将宿主在战斗中刚种下的若蛊转变为未识主且已成活的若蛊，或将宿主的已成活的若蛊转变为成蛊；\n还会使宿主发起生育行为的概率翻倍；宿主未在附近有异性的情况下进行月份更替时会受到随机3种毒素，每种3600点</align>

r7c3.en: <align="center">The host's negative "traits" will temporarily change their negative effects on all of the host's Primary Attributes\u002c Secondary traits\u002c Hit\u002c Deflect\u002c Attack\u002c Defense\u002c and Talent into positive ones.</align>
r7c3.cn: <align="center">宿主的负面「特性」对宿主的所有主要属性、次要属性、命中、化解、攻击、防御、资质的负面影响会暂时变化为正面影响</align>

r7c4.en: <align="center">The host's positive "traits" will temporarily change their positive effects on all of the host's Primary Attributes\u002c Secondary traits\u002c Hit\u002c Deflect\u002c Attack\u002c Defense\u002c and Talent into negative ones.</align>
r7c4.cn: <align="center">宿主的正面「特性」对宿主的所有主要属性、次要属性、命中、化解、攻击、防御、资质的正面影响会暂时变化为负面影响</align>

r7c5.en: <align="center">Any individual who makes intimate contact with the host will be inflicted with an un-attuned Prismatic Gu Larva.</align>
r7c5.cn: <align="center">与宿主肌肤相亲的所有人物都会被种下未识主的青髓若蛊</align>
